Emma / Stephanie —

Thanks for the redlines. I reviewed the doc and summarized our position below so we can close quickly. High-level: we can accept most operational asks with limited carveouts; there are three items that will require explicit legal tradeoffs or procurement approval.

1) Fine-tuning / retention language — We need to separate customer-supplied training corpora (we can commit to deletion within 90 days of contract termination unless otherwise agreed) from technical telemetry/logs (30 days standard, optional extended retention on dedicated/private). Proposed language: "Customer Training Data: retained only as directed in Order Form; standard deletion 90 days post-termination unless Customer elects archival for model reproducibility."

2) Subprocessor notice cadence — We do not support per-deal approval for routine infra subprocessors. We offer 30-day advance notice for new subprocessors + right to object for material changes (with defined escalations). For specialized on-prem or custom infra subprocessors, we can propose a separate exhibit with specific names and controls.

3) Cross-border transfer / SCCs — For EU customers we use standard SCCs plus a Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA). If you need additional contractual safe harbor (narrow transfer addendum that limits international processing), we can surface a TIA + routing clause in the Order Form. That should satisfy compliance while keeping the DPA consistent across accounts.

Action items (we propose):
- Laura: prepare redline of Bluehaven_DPA_v1 with the three proposed alternatives tracked.
- Stephanie: confirm whether the fine-tuning data is Customer-provided corpora or telemetry.
- Emma / Bluehaven: signal whether the three-week procurement deadline is fixed.

If the timeline is firm, we can prioritize an "order form + transfer annex" route which shortens the legal review (DPA standardized + tailored annex). If timing is flexible, Laura will produce a consolidated DPA redline and we can go line-by-line.

Irene Choi
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference
